items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Could there have been a Willie or a Philip?

ctx.x: Now, uh, they had, you heard of Philip Nixon, huh? Mm-hmm. He was a famous guitar player. Philip Nixon. Well, who was Sam Nixon? Sam Nixon was his brother. Wow. He's a bass player. Yeah. He was a bass player, too. Sam Nixon, yeah.

Well, would those guys go around and serenade ever? No. They played in standing band. Oh. Yes, indeed. No. Well, there were some others in that family that played, huh? I don't remember. Willie? Could there have been a Willie or a Philip?
Philip. All I knew, the only one I knew who played guitar was, uh, Philip and Sammy.
